pull_request.title: Calorimeter: investigate reusable LAr placements for faster Geant4 startup
pull_request.head: codex/lar-geant4-placement
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Investigates the Si–W placement approach for the ALLEGRO-style LAr ECAL. Opt-in reusable solid period mothers preserve the existing inclined barrel/turbine geometry and readout. In one matched serial ECAL-only pair, time to first actual event falls from **522.258 s to 67.383 s (7.75×)**; DDG4 map construction falls from **3.858 s to 0.195 s (19.79×)**. Peak child RSS falls from 5.538 GiB to 2.417 GiB.

The legacy assembly export remains the default. This is a draft prototype for review before the deferred 10k response comparison.

## Change

DES032/DES033 period envelopes follow the existing outer absorber faces and annular/axial clipping. Standalone exporters add `--real-periods`; all physical leaves, materials, replica poses and readout definitions are retained. The new mothers reuse the actual enclosing material, with no intended added material layer.

[Report, compact evidence and complete reproduction recipe](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-geant4-placement/docs/validation/lar-placement/README.md).

## Dashboard and validation

- [x] Updated scientific tracking and software inventory; inventory checks pass.
- [x] 39 LAr/placement controls and five baseline-composition controls pass.
- [x] Native barrel, endcap and combined ECAL checks report zero overlaps/extrusions at 10 nm; 405 union rays retained. All 65 matched material-ray differences are zero.
- [x] All 43,648 sensitive IDs and 274,689 terminal material-leaf records have identical inventory hashes. Canonical-cell checks retain 3,488,768 logical cells.
- [x] Both seven-event smoke samples pass primary and complete canonical-ID checks, covering the barrel and all turbine wheels on both ends. Counts and summed energies agree in these smoke cases.
- [x] Session validation and token-site build pass; unavailable usage remains unknown.
- [x] New Git objects inspected: no raw ROOT/events/compacts, dumps or large logs committed.
- [x] Added this PR's individual interaction record and linked canonical session; unavailable token observations remain unknown.
- [x] Separate PhysVal assessment and software guard-remediation review retained at exact revisions; no human approval inferred.
- [x] Layout drawings are unaffected: optional hierarchy only, with existing physical coordinates, dimensions and default selection retained.

The primary timing includes common inventory/native-map audit overhead. It is one observed serial pair, not isolated voxelization, stable throughput, twelve-worker qualification or general shower-response equivalence. The earlier failed MT pilot is not used as the baseline. No detector/design acceptance or merge authorization is implied.

User request (exact): “Let's do one thing first: - create a new PR where you inspect the same (re-)placement possibility as done for the Si-W calorimeter also for the ALLIGRO one, aiming at shortening the initialization time of Gean4”.

The assistant treated this as an explicit priority change before the10kresponse
campaign. That unfinished work, its76ed5ce9/221ae331 commits and local uncommitted
records remain preserved in the separate `nodd-lar-10k-response` worktree. No10k
production run was launched. This task uses a new initially-clean worktree,
`codex/lar-geant4-placement`, starting at
`8e99bdb90ca710e07067150a9e34bea3516e9127`.
